newsitem.title: TURKEY: Islamist mayor arrested after anti-Israel rally.
newsitem.headline: Islamist mayor arrested after anti-Israel rally.

text.p: Police on Wednesday arrested the Islamist mayor of an Ankara district where an anti-Israel rally was held last week, Anatolian news agency reported.
Police have taken Bekir Yildiz, mayor of Ankara's Sincan district, to Ankara's state security court for questioning, the agency said.
Yildiz enraged secularists in Turkey after hosting a day of anti-Israel protests at the weekend which culminated in calls for the implementation of Islamic sharia law.
In an apparent show of strength by the army -- historically wary of radical Islamists -- a convoy of tanks and military vehicles paraded through the area on Tuesday.

Two leftist parties worried by the increasingly Islamist direction of policy by the senior government partner, the Welfare party, to which Yildiz belongs, were prompted by the rally to file censure motions against the government on Wednesday.
Yildiz was suspended from duty on Tuesday when a warrant for his arrest was issued, but police were unable to track him down until Wednesday, Anatolian said.
